description: This file defines the OpenIdValidationConfiguration class which configures OpenID Connect validation options within an OrchardCore module, including setting up token validation, signing/encryption keys, tenant-specific data protection, and API authorization schemes.

classes.name: OpenIdValidationConfiguration
classes.description: A class implementing multiple configuration options for OpenID validation within OrchardCore, including authentication, token validation, data protection, and API authorization.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures AuthenticationOptions, setting up the validation scheme based on tenant settings.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures OpenIddictValidationOptions, setting issuer, signing keys, encryption keys, and token validation parameters.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures OpenIddictValidationDataProtectionOptions, setting data protection provider based on tenant.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures ApiAuthorizationOptions, setting the API authentication scheme.

methods.name: CreateTenantScope
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a shell scope for a specified tenant, optimizing for current tenant.

methods.name: GetServerSettingsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves and validates OpenID server settings asynchronously.

methods.name: GetValidationSettingsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves and validates OpenID validation settings asynchronously.
